== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Karoshans are a species of highly capable beings who possess physical advantages over humans in nearly every category. They are characterized by their massive stature, typically standing between nine and twelve feet tall, and thick skin. Their most striking physical feature is their hair, which consists of glowing, cable-like strands in various colors such as neon, bronze, yellow, or indigo. While their expressions can be difficult for humans to interpret, they are known for being eloquent and possessing a disciplined demeanor. Biologically, Karoshans frequently give birth to twins or triplets, though single births occur. Some individuals, known as [[The Perfected|the Perfected]], are physically leaner but possess enhanced strength and speed through a dangerous process of sacrificing many of their kin to concentrate power. Politically and militarily, the Karoshans are a formidable force. They are led by a monarchy, including figures such as [[King Regent|King-Regent Felrex]] and members of the royal family like [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] and [[Prince Veshran|Veshran]]. Their technology is distinct, featuring blocky, black spacecraft ranging from standard cruisers to massive six-mile-long dreadnoughts. These vessels often utilize [[Aethertech]] and are frequently accompanied by starfighters. Karoshan society values alchemy, which serves many roles similar to [[enchantment]] on other worlds. While they have a reputation as terrifying soldiers in galactic legends, they also maintain complex social structures involving intelligence agents and well-dressed nobility. However, darker [[aspects]] of their civilization exist, such as highly secured royal laboratories used for experimental procedures that involve merging organic matter with machinery or altering biological forms.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Karoshan are an eloquent species of warriors associated with the colony of [[Karosha]] and various pirate groups. These people, who are considered superior to humans in nearly every respect, possess hair that grows from the back of their helmets in thick, neon-like strands. Their soldiers utilize [[plasma]] rifles and standard infantry helmets, while their patrols employ [[Aethertech]] to identify individuals. Although they are currently engaged in a war with the [[Lichborn]], [[Telappen Vashei|President Vashei]] has worked to improve relations with them. While most Karoshans are matched in strength by the [[Iron King]], they remain a formidable presence in the galaxy.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Karoshan are a faction of exiles serving under the [[Rebel Queen]], [[Shyrax the Third]]. This group consists of vessels that fly alongside [[The Last Horizon]] and includes [[Combat Artist|Combat Artists]] who wear generic black uniforms with featureless black helmets. During their operations, the Karoshan have seized an [[Advocate]] shuttle and were observed watching [[Mell D-One-Twenty-Five|Mell]] and the narrator. While their ships narrowly avoided an attack by [[the Advocates]], they eventually engaged as enemies in a battle where their cruisers were seen retreating. Following this conflict, the group began sweeping the system for debris.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|As one of the five intelligent species in the galaxy, the Karoshans are high-level [[Combat Artist|Combat Artists]] who utilize mages that chant to the [[Aether]]. These beings, known as [[The Perfected|the Perfected]], stand nine or ten feet tall with neon cables instead of hair and possess scanning technology superior to that of the [[D’Niss]]. They maintain a fleet of blocky black ships and colonies, utilizing [[Nova-Bots|Nova-Bot]] vessels to protect their lives. Although they are allies of [[The Empire|the Empire]], they also function as an enemy group that demands the heads of those entering their system. During recent conflicts, a purple Karoshan was seen retrieving a [[plasma pistol]] from the remains of [[Omega]].}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Karoshans are an indigo-skinned species characterized by lashing tails, sharp fangs, and a birth rate that exceeds human standards. While refugees of the race reside on the planet [[Basyrryx]], they maintain a tradition of washing in a basin upon entering a home. As allies of [[Visiria]], their fleet of black, blocky ships provides essential cover fire for their comrades. This group has conducted research on the [[Iron Legion]] and provided vital data, including a rebel fleet that [[Sola Kalter|Sola]] recognizes as allies. Despite their collective strength, the laboratory located on [[Karosha]] is limited to a capacity of only one individual.}}
